storyboard.label: Hook
storyboard.visual: POV hands on wheel turning, whine begins
storyboard.vo: That whine when you turn the wheel?

storyboard.label: Setup
storyboard.vo: That's not normal — and it's not going to fix itself.

storyboard.label: Value1
storyboard.visual: X-ray cutaway: pump fluid with air bubbles
storyboard.vo: Low fluid lets air into the pump — that air is the whine you're hearing.

storyboard.label: Value2
storyboard.vo: Keep driving on it, and that air wears the pump's seals down.

storyboard.label: Value3
storyboard.visual: Macro: reservoir cap lifted, low fluid line
storyboard.vo: Five-minute check: pop the hood, look at the reservoir line.

storyboard.label: Value4
storyboard.visual: POV hands on wheel, smooth turn, whine gone
storyboard.vo: Catch it early, it's a top-off. Wait, and it's a pump.

storyboard.label: CTA
storyboard.vo: Worth checking before the whine turns into a bigger bill.
